strings.meta.title: pdff — Huza, hungura kandi uhindure PDF, Word, Excel ku buntu
strings.meta.description: Igikoresho co kuri interineti ku buntu co guhuza, guhindura, kugabanya uburemere, gutera no Kurinda dosiye zawe za PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint n'amashusho. Ntihakenewe kwiyandikisha, dosiye zisibaakoako.
strings.meta.keywords: huza pdf, hungura pdf, pdf kuri word, word kuri jpg, jpg kuri pdf, pdf kuri jpg, gabanya uburemere bwa pdf, tana pdf, excel kuri pdf, ibikoresho vya pdf ku buntu
strings.footer.text: Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha. Dosiye zawe zisiba uko igikorwa kirangiye.

strings.workspace.approximate: Kuva kuri PDF,imiterere irasubirwamwo: ibyara bishobora gukenera gusubirwamwo, cane cane ku nyandiko yafashwe na scanner.

strings.language.failed: Gusobanura mu rurimi rwa {lang} vyanze. Nyamuneka gerageza kandi hanyuma.
strings.seo.why[0].title: Ku buntu 100%
strings.seo.why[0].text: Nta bwishyu bw'ukwezi, nta karata ya banki, nta kimenyetso c'akamenyo congewe ku nyandiko zawe.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Nta kwiyandikisha
strings.seo.why[1].text: Nta konti yo gufungura: fungura urupapuro, jana dosiye zawe, birangiye.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Dosiye zawe ziguma ari izawe
strings.seo.why[2].text: Biratunganywa, maze bigasibwa ako kanya. Ntitubika inyandiko zawe canke amakuru yawe.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Imiterere yose
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, amashusho, EPUB… kuva kuri mudasobwa canke telefone.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Mbega pdff ni ku buntu koko?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ego cane. Igikoresho cose ni ku buntu, nta kimenyetso c'akamenyo kandi nta kibuze inyuma y'ubwishyu bw'ukwezi. Nta karata ya banki isabwa.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Oya. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta aderesi ya imeyili: ukoresha ibikoresho ako kanya.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Oya. Dosiye zawe zikoreshwa gusa ku gikorwa waciye ubaza, maze zigasibwa. Nta n'umwe uzisoma kandi ntizigera zisangiwa.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ego. pdff ikora mu mucaca w'amaterefone yose, tablet canke mudasobwa (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), nta kintu co gushiramwo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, amashusho (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML n'izindi.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ushobora gutunganya dosiye zitageze kuri {files} rimwe, kandi inyandiko isohotse ishobora kugira impapuro zigeze kuri {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ibanga
strings.privacy.description: Uburyo pdff yitwararika dosiye zawe: nta konti, nta nyandiko ibitswe, nta matangazo n'ukugurisha amakuru.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yubatswe kugira inyandiko zawe zigume ari izawe. Hejuru yaho, mu majambo asanzwe, ni iki kiba iyo uyikoresheje.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosiye zawe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zirungikwa zifunitse (HTTPS), zigatunganywa mu buryo bwikora, maze zigasibwa uko ibyavuyemwo biba biteguriye. Dosiye nini zica mu bubiko bw'igihe gito ku izina ry'akajagari kandi zisibwa igikorwa kirangiye; isukurwa ryikora risiba ikindi cose cosigara mu masaha 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Nta konti, nta makuru yihariye
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ntisaba kwiyandikisha, aderesi ya imeyili canke karata ya banki. Inyandiko zawe ntizemewe gusomwa, gusesengurwa, gusangirwa canke gukoreshwa mu kwigisha ubwenge bw'ubukorozi (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Igipimo c'abasura
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubarira ingendo mu buryo bw'ibanga nta kimenyetso c'ukwibuka (Vercel Web Analytics) kugira tumenye ibikoresho bifise akamaro. Nta matangazo, nta gukurikirana.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ubwibuka
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Agatonyanga kamwe k'ubwibuka gashobora guhitamwo: kwibuka ururimi wahisemo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ubwakiriro
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Urubuga rwakirwa na Vercel ku maseriveri i Paris; ihindurwa rya Word, Excel na PowerPoint rifashwa na Render i Frankfurt. Aba batanga seriveri bitwararika dosiye gusa igihe zihindurwa.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Twandikire
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ikibazo canke iciyumviro? Twandikire ku rupapuro rw'umushinga:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Huza
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Huza dosiye zitandukanye (PDF, Word, amashusho…) muri PDF imwe, mu rutonde wahisemo.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Huza dosiye za PDF kuri interineti ku buntu (Word, amashusho, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Huza dosiye za PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint n'amashusho muri PDF imwe, mu rutonde ushaka. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha, nta kimenyetso c'akamenyo, dosiye zisiba ako kanya.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Shira impapuro zawe zose mu dosiye imwe: pdff yakira PDF ariko kandi n'inyandiko za Word, impapuro za Excel, ivyerekana n'amashusho, ikabihuza mu PDF imwe n'agafunguzo ku dosiye imwe.

strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Hindura inyandiko iyo ari yo yose canke ishusho mu yindi miterere.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Hindura PDF kuri Word, Word kuri PDF, JPG kuri PDF — ku buntu
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Igikoresho co guhindura ku buntu: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB n'imiterere irenga 40. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha, ubwiza burhanzwe.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Igikoresho co guhindura ku miterere yose: Word kuri PDF, PDF kuri Word, JPG kuri PDF, PDF kuri JPG, Excel kuri PDF, PowerPoint kuri PDF, PNG kuri JPG, EPUB kuri PDF… Kurura dosiye zawe maze pdff itange gusa imiterere ishoboka.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Tana PDF mu dosiye zitandukanye: kuva ku rupapuro rumwe gushika ku rundi canke urupapuro ku rupapuro.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Tana PDF kuri interineti ku buntu — tandukanya impapuro
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Tana PDF mu dosiye zitandukanye: kuva ku rupapuro rumwe gushika ku rundi, urupapuro ku rupapuro canke buri mpapuro N. Ku buntu, vuba kandi nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Rungika igice gusa c'inyandiko nini gifise akamaro: pdff itana PDF yawe mu bice wahisemo maze ikagarukana udupande mu bubiko bwa ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gumiza canke siba impapuro zihariye za PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Kuramo canke siba impapuro muri PDF — ku buntu
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gumiza gusa impapuro ukeneye muri PDF, canke siba iziremereye. Ku buntu, ku interineti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta kimenyetso c'akamenyo.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Urupapuro rwera, umugereka utagira akamaro, agashusho kabiri? Andika impapuro zo kugumiza canke gusiba (nk'akarorero 1-3, 7, 10-end) maze ubone PDF nziza mu masegonda.

strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Hindura urutonde rw'impapuro, gukoporora, gusubiza inyuma.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Tondeka impapuro za PDF kuri interineti — ku buntu
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Hindura urutonde rw'impapuro za PDF, koporora zimwe canke subiza inyuma inyandiko yose. Ku buntu, ku interineti, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Impapuro zafashwe na scanner ziri mu kajagari? Andika urutonde rushasha (nk'akarorero 3, 1, 2, 4-end) canke subiza inyuma inyandiko yose: pdff irakora ibindi.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Zungurutsa impapuro zose za PDF canke zimwe zonyene, kuri 90°, 180° canke 270°. Ku buntu, vuba, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Icyangombwa cyasomwe gihunitse cyangwa urupapuro rw'uburinganire? Zungurutsa inyandiko yose cyangwa gusa impapuro wahisemo, nta gihombo cy'ubwiza.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Yongera nimero ku mpapuro za PDF: hitamo aho ziri, imiterere ya "1 / 10", nimero ya mbere n'ubunini. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Bikwiye ku gisigo, dosiye yo gusaba akazi canke raporo: hitamo aho ziri, imiterere na nimero ya mbere, maze pdff ishyire nimero ku mpapuro zawe neza.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Gabanya PDF kugira uyirungikire kuri imeyili cyangwa uyishyire ku rubuga rwa Leta. Ingero zitatu zo kugabanya, ku buntu.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Urubuga rwanze dosiye yawe kuko iremereye cane? Gabanya uburemere bwa PDF yawe mu gihe ugumisha inyandiko zibonerana: hitamo uburyo bwiza, ubwasabwe cyangwa ubukomeye bitewe n'uburemere ukeneye.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Funga PDF n'ijambo ry'ibanga (AES-256) maze uhagarike gucapura, gukoporora cyangwa guhindura. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Imbere yo kurungika urupapuro rw'umushahara cyangwa inyandiko y'ubuvuzi, ifunge n'ijambo ry'ibanga rikomeye: nta ryo, nta n'umwe ushobora kuyifungura.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Kuraho ijambo ry'ibanga rya PDF uzi ijambo ryayo, kugira ngo uyifungure, uyicapure cyangwa uyihuze mu bwisanzure. Ku buntu.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uzi ijambo ry'ibanga, ariko kurandika buri gihe birarushya? Rikureho rimwe na rimwe. pdff ntigera inyura ku ijambo ry'ibanga utazi.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Reka ubusa niba PDF ifise gusa ijambo ry'ibanga ry'uruhusha.

strings.tools.metadonnees.intro: Umutwe werekanywe mu idirishya ry'ububiko cyangwa izina ry'umwanditsi bitanga icyitegererezo cya kera? Kosora ibiranga inyandiko, cyangwa ubisibe imbere yo gusangira.
